free_tier.stated: Free sandbox for oneAPI work: 120 days of access with extensions available, 192 GB RAM, 220 GB of file storage, remote desktop for the oneAPI Rendering Toolkit, VS Code integration and a Linux terminal, across Intel Xeon Scalable CPUs, Intel Iris Xe MAX GPUs and Stratix 10 / Arria 10 FPGAs.
